snippet.title: Drum Incremental — Official Trailer | Idle game with real drum rudiments
snippet.description:
Drum Incremental is an incremental game where every click is a real percussion rudiment. Tap patterns on your practice pad, earn Rhythm Points, unlock all 40 PAS rudiments across 5 phases, pass the boss exams, and grow your setup from a beginner's pad to a pro station. Original soundtrack that follows your tempo live. Full controller support, 10 languages.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4656440/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer
Free demo at Steam Next Fest, October 19-26 · Launching November 2, 2026

#idlegame #incrementalgame #rhythmgame #indiegame #drums
